tags.name: Foote Creek Rim
tags.note: Foote Creek I was built in 1999 with 69 small turbines, repowered in 2020 with 13 larges turbines. Foote Creek II-IV was built with 64 small turbines, repowered in 2024 with 11 larges turbines. Rock River I repowered with 19 larges turbines.
